lab.name: S3 Research Lab — Zettelkasten + Compiler Optimization
lab.purpose: Durable compiler-research workspace and conversation handoff state

p4_result.earliest_memory_identity_layer: emitter frame canonicalization after the default backend selected RA_OFF
p4_result.selected_model: existing liveness-backed global value residency with explicit stack-backed opt-out
p4_result.selected_transformation: make register allocation the native default while preserving register_allocation=false fallback

established_findings.post_m138: massive representation/lowering expansion; backend/codegen immaturity rather than language-fundamental cost
established_findings.p1: bounds/control lowering compressed branches and code size but did not reduce load/store count
established_findings.p2: same-basic-block scalar forwarding is safe/useful but removes only limited frame traffic
established_findings.p3: safe cross-block scalar residence removes targeted frame moves but large representative global counters remain effectively unchanged
established_findings.p4: the existing whole-function liveness-backed allocator was already capable of global value residency but register_allocation defaulted false; making it the native default cut direct frame loads/stores substantially without an allocator redesign
established_findings.ra_primary_cause: NO — allocator enablement/default policy was a major cause; allocator algorithm quality was not established as primary
established_findings.current_secondary_target: SSA destruction and memory-state metadata staging
established_findings.metric_interpretation: P4 external GCC-relative slowdown worsened because the comparator denominator varied, while absolute S3 ns/parse improved 5.46%; keep causal structural, absolute S3, and comparator-relative metrics separate

research_direction.primary_question: Why are memory/initialized-state metadata repeatedly materialized after ordinary value residency was improved, and what fraction originates in SSA destruction versus later metadata staging?
research_direction.ternary_question: Can S3 keep trit semantics abstract long enough to choose a cheaper physical representation/control realization?
research_direction.information_question: Which semantic, representation, memory-validity and proof facts are irreversibly lost or repeatedly re-materialized at each lowering boundary?
candidate_models: residence lattice / reduced product abstract domain
Lagrangian relaxation of shared register-capacity coupling
bounded proof/fact preservation across compiler phases

hard_rules.production_changes_from_lab: port proven ideas to a fresh branch from current main
hard_rules.full_suite_policy: production final candidate only; not routine research iteration
hard_rules.ternary_semantics_policy: do not change S3 semantics merely to match a named many-valued logic
hard_rules.information_metric_policy: do not assign Shannon entropy/mutual-information metrics without a defined probabilistic model
hard_rules.quantum_dna_policy: multiple-valued quantum/DNA sources are architecture inspiration only; no such backend is implied
hard_rules.metric_policy: separate direct causal structural metrics, absolute S3 runtime, and external comparator-relative ratios
